title: The Heir Calls Back
description:
Three months since you handed over your card in that elevator.
You'd almost forgotten about it.
Today an unknown number texted.
'Hi. Do you remember the elevator that time? Could we meet briefly?'

choices.result_text:
A Gangnam café. He arrived first.
"A lot of people hand me cards, but giving mine out — that was a first for me."
An hour of conversation.
He didn't want anything. He was just — curious about the person.
He left his number. Where this goes, unknown.

choices.text: Cautious. Find out who he is first.
choices.result_text:
You searched. It checked out. That was him.
Knowing the background made it feel more delicate.
You never replied.
Whether it was an opportunity or a risk — still unknown.

title: Their Proposal
description:
At the Sangchul network event you'd approached that guaranteed-returns group in the corner.
Today one of them reached out.
"You seemed interested back then. A spot just opened up.
22% in three months. Corporate structure."

choices.text: Look into it — understand the structure first
choices.result_text:
You dug into the FSS website.
Six prosecuted cases with similar structures came up.
You hung up.
'Guaranteed returns' is itself illegal.
Checking was the right move.

choices.text: Put in a small amount to test it
choices.result_text:
You put in ₩3 million.
Two months later, contact went dark.
You reported to the FSS. An investigation opened.
The ₩3 million didn't come back.
There are no easy paths in the Gangnam network.

'Not really my style.'
The other person said 'We'll be in touch again.'
You blocked them.

title: What Happened to That Property
description:
The redevelopment villa deal you turned down from Im Sangchul.
Today Sangchul called.
"Minjun. Remember that property?
Redevelopment consortium approval came through today."

choices.text: "Good for you. I'm still building up."
choices.result_text:
Sangchul said, "It's a shame — but being careful isn't wrong."
If you'd entered then, it would've been 1.8x by now.
There's something you didn't lose either. But it stayed on your mind a long time.

Sangchul said 'Sure. There's always another deal.'
Another opportunity will come.
This one slipped by — but the relationship with Sangchul remains.

title: Building Goes to Auction
description:
You'd let the talk of the landlord's debt slide back then.
Today there was an auction notice posted on the door.
The building was going to foreclosure.
Your deposit is tied up.

choices.text: File a claim on the lease deposit insurance
choices.result_text:
You filed with HUG.
Three months later the full deposit came through.
You let out a long breath.
Good thing you'd signed up for the insurance.
You shouldn't have ignored it back then — but luck was on your side.

choices.text: Register your lease rights and fight it legally
choices.result_text:
You hired a lawyer. ₩2 million out.
Some would come back through the auction distribution, but not the full amount.
If you'd pulled the registry one more time back then, that would've been enough.
Knowing and acting like you know are different things.

title: That Villa in the News
description:
Five months since you re-checked the registry after the lease fraud news.
Today a portal article came up.
[28 Tenants in Nearby Villa Lose Deposit]
The building in the photo looked familiar. Two blocks away.

choices.result_text:
All clear.
It's a scary world.
Knowing — just knowing — was protection here.

You shared it to a KakaoTalk group.
Someone you knew lived near there.
"Thanks. I just checked mine because of this." They replied.
A small thing — but it reached someone.

title: A Post on the Community Board
description:
Two months since you took the cash and dropped the wallet in a mailbox.
Today a post appeared in the neighborhood community.
[Lost Item] Lost a wallet near the bus stop.
There's a memorial photo of my father inside. The cash doesn't matter. Please.

choices.result_text:
You paid it back the only way you could.
₩300,000 and a note.
'I found your wallet that day. Late, but I'm returning this.'
After sending it, you stood there for a while.

You closed the screen.
The words — 'my father's memorial photo' — stayed in front of your eyes for a long time.
Even now, that post comes back sometimes.

title: That Bus Stop
description:
Today you passed that bus stop again. The one where you walked past the wallet.
Nothing special about it. But it kept coming back.
When you'd picked it up and looked at the ID — for a moment you'd imagined who that person was.

choices.text: Decide: next time, don't just walk past
choices.result_text:
Not a formal resolution.
Just — I won't do that again next time.
Somehow that felt like something had changed.

You didn't have the margin back then.
Can't say you have the margin now either.
But it keeps coming back, and there's nothing you can do about that.

title: Correction
description:
A month ago you'd put in ₩3 million because everyone was piling in.
Today you opened the account.
Current valuation: ₩221,000.
Return: -26.3%

choices.result_text:
You sold. ₩790,000 loss.
You left the group chat.
'Everyone else is doing it' is the most expensive tuition.
I put in another million won. My average cost came down. Recovery was just a matter of time now, I believed.

title: Hyeonsu's Message
description:
In the goshiwon shared kitchen, you told Hyeonsu: 'I'm going to Gangnam. In five years.'
Today a KakaoTalk from Hyeonsu.
'Hey, you said Gangnam in five years back then. How long's left now?'

choices.result_text:
Hyeonsu said 'Okay. When you make it, tell me too.'
Still on my way.
That's true.

'...Yeah. A lot has changed.'
Hyeonsu said 'That's part of growing up, I think.'
The {name} who made that declaration wasn't wrong.
The {name} now is right too.

title: Life After Deleting the App
description:
Ten months since you deleted Instagram.
Today a friend asked, 'Why don't you have Insta anymore?'
'I deleted it,' you said.
'Why?' they asked.
You paused for a second thinking about how to explain.

choices.result_text:
The friend was quiet for a moment, then said '...Same for me actually.'
After that, things felt easier with that friend.
One honest sentence can shift a relationship.

'Just.' That was it.
The friend didn't push.
This decision doesn't need an explanation.

title: The Smell of the Fuel
description:
Ten months of running on 'I'll show them.'
Today you were tired for no reason.
You didn't want to do anything.
Anger gets you far — but the exhaust comes back to you eventually.

choices.text: Find a different engine. Not anger.
choices.result_text:
Anger is fast fuel but it burns to ash.
You shifted toward wanting to build something.
Slower — but it smelled less.

choices.text: This tiredness is part of the process. Keep going.
choices.result_text:
You kept going.
Tired, but not stopped.
Whether that's right or not — you'll know later.

title: A Reply from a Friend
description:
Six months ago you told an old classmate: 'Honestly, things aren't going well.'
Today a KakaoTalk.
'Hey, I failed another job hunt. I wanted to tell you first.'

choices.text: "Thanks for telling me. Let's get something to eat."
choices.result_text:
You met up.
Neither of you was doing well, but the meal was somehow good.
Honest people find each other.

You sent the comfort.
Friend said 'Thanks.'
You wished you had more to give.

title: Time to Pay Back
description:
Ten months since you borrowed the MLM card debt from your father.
The fact that he didn't ask anything at the time — it'd stayed with you.
You looked at the balance. You can repay ₩3 million.

choices.result_text:
You transferred and called.
Dad said 'Hello?'
'Dad, I sent back what I borrowed that time.'
A short silence. 'It's fine.' That's what he said.
That 'it's fine' stayed with you for a long time.

choices.text: Save a bit more and repay it all at once
choices.result_text:
You decided to save more and repay in one go.
That's the practical approach.
But maybe a phone call would've been enough already.

title: A Police Call
description:
Five months since you touched that burner account and got out.
Today an unknown number called.
'Hello, this is the Cyber Investigation Unit.
We have a few things to ask you.'

choices.result_text:
You explained that you'd returned the money and contributed something to the victim.
The investigator said: 'So you removed yourself voluntarily.'
The questioning was long. You could've been charged as the account holder.
A month later, 'No grounds for prosecution' came through.
Getting out that day was right.

₩2 million for a lawyer.
They said 'It's a good thing you stepped away early. You can get leniency.'
It ended with a suspended indictment.
Expensive — but it could've been more.

title: Father at Twenty-Three
description:
Six months ago you heard the story of your father coming up to Seoul for the first time at twenty-three.
Today mid-call, you just asked.
'Dad, what was it like when you first came to Seoul back then?'

choices.result_text:
Your father talked for a long time.
Scared when he stepped off at Seoul Station. Nearly starved for a month with no money.
It didn't look that different from where {name} is now.
After hanging up, you stayed still for a while.
Like you were walking the same road.

choices.text: "You really went through a lot, Dad."
choices.result_text:
Dad said 'All in the past.'
But that old story stayed with you for a long time.
Dad walked this road too.

title: Dad's Blood Pressure
description:
Your father who mentioned he was on blood pressure medication.
Six months passed.
Today a call from your aunt.
'Minjun. Your dad had a full check-up. Everything's fine, they said. I was worried — thank goodness.'

choices.result_text:
Dad said 'It's nothing really.'
'Still, I'm glad you're okay.'
After hanging up, you felt a weight lift.
Good that you'd asked back then.

'Auntie, thank you for telling me.'
She said 'Call your dad too.'
You said you would.

title: A Second Client
description:
Two months since completing the first freelance job.
Today a text from an unknown number.
'Hello, I was referred by someone who knows you.
Could I ask for similar work?'

choices.text: Take it. Raise the rate this time.
choices.result_text:
Agreed on ₩500,000. Up from ₩300,000 last time.
You wrote a contract this time too.
So this is how word of mouth spreads.
Finishing the first job well got you here.

choices.text: Decline. Want to focus elsewhere right now.
choices.result_text:
You politely declined.
Said to please reach out another time.
Having options — that was something that came from finishing the first job.
